definitions.ask: When no Pomodoro is running, should Control-\ still land on the nearest Pomodoro line instead of the note's top?
definitions.why: Between sessions, the next planned Pomodoro is where work resumes

choices.label: Land on the first open Pomodoro, else the last completed one, else the note's first line
Open today's note at its first line whenever nothing is running
Keep the panel open with "No Pomodoro is running" and open nothing
